cases.subject: Ibrahim sacrifice-test son

quran.claim: The son is not named in the Qur’anic Arabic text.

supplement.claim: The Torah textual witness names Isaac.

cases.rule: Do not project the supplementary identification into Qur’anic wording.

cases.subject: Idris Enoch identification

quran.claim: Idris is named and described as siddiq and nabi.

supplement.claim: Enoch walks with God and is taken.

cases.rule: Traditional identification remains low-confidence and non-automatic.

cases.subject: Musa name etymology

quran.claim: Qur’an provides Mūsā without historical etymology.

supplement.claim: Hebrew narrative gives a draw-out wordplay.

cases.rule: Keep Egyptian and Hebrew analyses separate.
